definition: Techniques for artificially expanding a training dataset by creating modified versions of existing data, such as rotations of images or paraphrases of text.
details: Data augmentation helps models generalize better by exposing them to greater variability during training without requiring additional labeled data collection.
story: Think of a hiker descending a foggy hill in the dark, taking small steps and feeling for the steepest way down. In plain words: Techniques for artificially expanding a training dataset by creating modified versions of existing data, such as rotations of images or paraphrases of text. Here is how it actually plays out: Data augmentation helps models generalize better by exposing them to greater variability during training without requiring additional labeled data collection. Skill, for a model, is just error pushed down until it is small enough to ignore. That steady, miss-by-miss improvement is Data Augmentation.
